num_real_activities: <int> Number of real activities in the project, excluding the dummy start and end activities.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of activities including the dummy start (node 0) and dummy end (node num_real_activities+1).
num_partially_renewable_resources: <int> Number of partially renewable resources constraining the project.
deadline: <int> Latest allowable time period by which the project end activity must be completed.
processing_times: <list[int], length num_nodes> Duration of each activity in whole time periods, where the dummy start and end activities have zero duration.

temporal_constraints.from: <int> Activity from which this temporal constraint originates.
temporal_constraints.to: <int> Activity to which this temporal constraint applies.
temporal_constraints.delta: <int> Required minimum difference between the start time of the destination activity and the start time of the origin activity.
temporal_constraints.type: <str> Whether this constraint enforces a minimum lag ('min_lag') or a maximum lag ('max_lag') between two activities.

num_temporal_constraints: <int> Total number of temporal constraints linking pairs of activities.

resources.resource_id: <int> Identifier for this partially renewable resource.
resources.time_periods: <list[int]> Designated subset of time periods from the planning horizon over which this resource's consumption is counted.
resources.capacity: <int> Maximum total resource consumption allowed across all activities for this resource.
resources.demands: <list[int], length num_nodes> Per-activity demand for this resource, indicating how much of the resource each activity consumes per designated time period it spans.
